Title: Generally Available: Azure Data Box 80 TB is now Generally available at Azure China

Body.Content:
We’re excited to share that the Azure Data Box 80 TB SKU is now generally available at Azure China. Azure Data Box is Azure’s offline data transfer solution that lets you copy petabytes of data into or from Azure Storage in a quick, inexpensive, and reliable way. The secure data transfer is accelerated using a proprietary Azure Data Box storage device. Customers in China can order a device to import or export data to/from any of the Azure China regions.

Learn more.
